'''DS-1234 Ominous Endor Operations''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DS-1234]]
* '''Published:''' 10 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 EOps DS-1234 DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is good, well rounded deck. Good drains in space, and undercover spies to block drains.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

First Turn: Before you activate, look though your deck for Wakeelmui and sack You Cannot Hide Forever to grab Combat Response. Deploy Ominous Rumors as soon as possible. Note you don't/can't flip the objective; its there to set up Ominous.

The rest is up to you. Try and Use Imperial Command to put Admiral Piet at the Bunker, then look for Commander Merrejk. Put them both at the Bunker, then throw Maul at the docking bay and move everyone over for free drain. If you can, also try and get Star Destroyers in close parsecs to each other, Chiraneu adding to drains there. Good Luck
